about: The knowledge pack's own placeholder list (scripts/knowledge-pack.ts): privacy hits it lets pass in
the pack only, never in this repository (never add these to herdr/scripts/privacy-list.json). Each is
an exact match or an anchored pattern for the email or home-path rule; never a person's name, home
or address. Only these kinds: example addresses, example WhatsApp JIDs, the generic homes /home/user,
/home/genie and /home/automagik, omni@<version> strings, the org's role contacts
(privacidade@, dpo@, security@), and three public service and tool addresses (exact
matches only; a new one needs Chat's word); knowledge-pack.test.ts fails on any other entry. A pattern
that matches empty text, has no literal part or matches unrelated text is refused at load.
Written with JSON escapes (\u0040 for the at sign, \/ for a slash) so the repository's own privacy
scan, which reads raw text, does not read them as addresses or paths.
